cases.task: Choose the safe retry-budget policy when an SSE page boundary is valid but its cursor equals the dashboard's current cursor.

required_facts.text: Equality is valid for a page boundary because it may confirm that no further cursor was examined.
An equal page makes no useful cursor progress.
Resetting retry attempts on ready(N), page(N), transport-error cycles permits unbounded reconnects.
Only a strictly advancing accepted event or page should reset the bounded transport-recovery budget.
